Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The repository provides comprehensive operational detail for independent replication. plan.md documents the experimental objectives, hypotheses, and methodology. CodeWalkthrough.md explains the code organization with five utility modules (eval_utils, extract_utils, intervention_utils, model_utils, prompt_utils). The main entry point evaluate_function_vector.py (228 lines) has comprehensive CLI arguments documenting all configurable parameters. The demo notebook (fv_demo.ipynb) provides a complete working example from model loading through evaluation. All analysis steps are specified: (1) load model/tokenizer, (2) load dataset, (3) filter via n-shot evaluation, (4) compute mean activations (100 trials), (5) compute indirect effects (25 trials), (6) extract function vector from top-k heads, (7) evaluate in zero-shot and shuffled-label contexts.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: fv_environment.yml provides a complete conda environment with pinned versions: Python 3.10, PyTorch 1.13.0 with CUDA 11.7, transformers 4.49.0, datasets 2.14.3, scikit-learn 1.3.0, baukit from git, bitsandbytes 0.45.3, accelerate 0.21.0. model_utils.py explicitly supports GPT-2 XL, GPT-J 6B, GPT-NeoX 20B, Llama 2 (7B/13B/70B), Pythia, and OLMo with standardized MODEL_CONFIG. 27+ datasets in dataset_files/abstractive/ use JSON format with {input, output} structure. All default parameters are documented in CLI: n_shots=10, n_mean_activations_trials=100, n_indirect_effect_trials=25, test_split=0.3, seed=42, n_top_heads=10, with explicit prefixes and separators.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: The set_seed() function in model_utils.py comprehensively controls randomness across Python (random.seed), NumPy (np.random.seed), PyTorch (torch.manual_seed, torch.cuda.manual_seed), cuDNN (torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True), and environment (PYTHONHASHSEED). evaluate_function_vector.py applies set_seed(seed) before every stochastic operation: dataset filtering, mean activation computation, indirect effect computation, and each evaluation run. Multi-trial averaging (100 trials for mean activations, 25 for indirect effects) reduces variance from random prompt sampling. torch.set_grad_enabled(False) ensures deterministic inference. Results are reproducible given the same random seed.
